meta.description: TDS section rates & thresholds for vendor / non-salary payments (194C, 194J, 194I ...). This file is the single source of truth. On any Union Budget / CBDT change, edit the numbers here (or add a new section) and save — the running system picks it up on the next request, no code change and no redeploy. Salary TDS (section 192) is NOT here: that is slab-based and lives in the DB via the /api/v1/hr/tax-slabs admin screen.
meta.threshold_semantics: per-payment amount at or below `threshold` => zero TDS; above => TDS on the full amount at the applicable rate
meta.rate_selection: sections with rate_ind/rate_other use rate_ind for deductee_type individual|huf and rate_other otherwise; sections with a single `rate` use it for everyone
